facts.text: “Pijnstiller” by Suzan & Freek entered the Dutch Top 40 straight at #1 this week.
“Magnetic” by The Bausa is in its 30th week in the Dutch Top 40.
“Dracula” by Tame Impala is in its 54th week in the US Hot 100.
“Mr. Brightside” by The Killers is in its 527th week in the UK Top 100.
